sources.title: Android ClipData HTML clips require a plain-text alternative
sources.note: Public newHtmlText, available since API16, advertises MIMETYPE_TEXT_HTML and requires its text argument as the plain-text alternative. A text/plain-only admission rule incorrectly rejects this standard Android clip. Console accepts text/plain or text/html metadata but reads only the supplied item.text after single-item and URI/Intent refusal; it never parses HTML or invokes coerceToText/provider access. The actual emulator workflow preserved this false-refusal failure before the adapter repair.

Independent review found a first-candidate DEL/selection-replay regression; failing-before cases reject that candidate, and the corrected bundle1e806cc8...ec3fe passes36 cases.
